definitions.explanation: Taking charge of and managing the practical aspects of running a business, household, or organization. Implies hands-on, day-to-day management.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm running the shop by myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My mother managed the household finances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: It's tough to run a company with a small number of people.

notes:
{切|き}り{盛|も}り means managing or running something with practical, hands-on effort. It often carries a nuance of doing it skillfully despite limited resources or difficult conditions.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally from cooking — ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) and ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ (to serve/plate) — referring to preparing and serving food. This extended to mean managing all aspects of an operation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run a shop
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manage household finances
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manage single-handedly
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run a company

USAGE:
Implies active, resourceful management. Often used to praise someone who handles everything capably: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切|き}り{盛|も}り⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (She's running the whole thing by herself).
